name: SortFields
description: The SortFields collection is a collection of SortField objects. It allows developers to store a sort state on workbooks, lists, and autofilters.
remarks: The object contains properties to add, count, sort, and remove SortField objects.
example:
ActiveWorksheet.SortFields.Add Key:=Range("A1"), Order:=xlDescending
ActiveWorksheet.SortFields.Add Key:=Range("B1"), Order:=xlDescending
ActiveWorksheet.SortFields.Sort Header:=xlGuess

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a SortField object that represents a collection of items that can be sorted in a workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Key As Range, [SortOn As Variant], [Order As Variant], [CustomOrder As Variant], [DataOption As Variant]) As SortField
methods.description: Creates a new sort field and returns a SortFields object.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Specifies a key value for the sort.

parameters.name: SortOn
parameters.description: An XlSortOn value that specifies which property of a cell to use for the sort.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: An XlSortOrder value that specifies the sort order.

parameters.name: CustomOrder
parameters.description: Specifies if a custom sort order should be used.

parameters.name: DataOption
parameters.description: An XlSortDataOption value that specifies how to sort text.

methods.name: Add2
methods.signature: Add2(Key As Range, [SortOn As Variant], [Order As Variant], [CustomOrder As Variant], [DataOption As Variant], [SubField As Variant]) As SortField
methods.description: Creates a new sort field and returns a SortFields object that can optionally sort data types with the SubField defined.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Specifies a key value for the sort.

parameters.name: SortOn
parameters.description: An XlSortOn value that specifies which property of a cell to use for the sort.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: An XlSortOrder value that specifies the sort order.

parameters.name: CustomOrder
parameters.description: Specifies if a custom sort order should be used.

parameters.name: DataOption
parameters.description: An XlSortDataOption value that specifies how to sort text.

parameters.name: SubField
parameters.description: Specifies the field to sort on for a data type (such as Population for Geography or Volume for Stocks).
